# AccessGUDID <img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="200"/>

## Installation

You can also install the development version of AccessGUDID

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("oxford-pharmacoepi/AccessGUDID")
```

## Brief description

## Single UDI mapping - Map via AccessGUDID API

## Multiple UDI mapping - Download AccesGUDID files

First, download the necessary files to do the mapping. These includes:

1.   Devices UDI and their corresponding SNOMED code. Files are downloaded from: https://accessgudid.nlm.nih.gov/resources/developers/v3/implant_list_download. To 
be able to download these files, you'll need a free UMLS licence account. If you don't have
one, follow the instructions in [this](https://documentation.uts.nlm.nih.gov/rest/authentication.html?_gl=1*ozdtii*_ga*MzE4NTczNTgxLjE3MDA2NjYyNTQ.*_ga_7147EPK006*czE3NzEwMDI0NTUkbzE4JGcxJHQxNzcxMDAyNTQyJGozNSRsMCRoMA..*_ga_P1FPTH9PL4*czE3NzEwMDI0NTUkbzE4JGcxJHQxNzcxMDAyNTQyJGozNSRsMCRoMA..) link.

2.   Devices description, brand, company, and catalogue number. Files are downloaded from:
https://accessgudid.nlm.nih.gov/download/delimited

You can download both files manually or using the following functions:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval= FALSE}
library(AccessGUDID)
library(here)
dir_snomed <- downloadSnomedFiles(apiKey = api_key,
                                  directory = here())

dir_files <- downloadFiles(directory = here())
```

We can now then use `getSnomed()` function to extract the SNOMED code for a list of UDIs


```{r, echo=TRUE, eval= FALSE}
map <- getSnomed(snomedFilesDirectory = dir_snomed,
                 filesDirectory = dir_files,
                 deviceDI = c("05415067030986", "00811806010366", "13661522039417"))

map
```
